description: R-SQL-1 SQL-J: How do outer and inner joins treat multiple matching right rows, duplicate left keys, Null left keys, Null right keys on the preserved side, and a WHERE that rejects some but not all matches of a left row (RX qty Null for L3)? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-1-accdb-main opened read-only through ACE DAO; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, Fields Name/Type/Size/SourceTable/SourceField are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
